notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is catalogued here — same shared uk-darwin.js provider as every other UK region, regionId rest-of-wales. Registry status stays `planned` (docs/jim-brief-rest-of-wales-flip.md) until Mark/Tim's flip call.

Single agency (National Rail, Transport for Wales franchisee), single mode (train). No second local network exists to exclude (unlike South Wales' Valley Lines) — see lib/providers/rest-of-wales.js file header.

Hub lock: Wrexham General (WRX) only — junction of North Wales Main Line, North Wales Coast Line, and Borderlands Line. Not Wrexham Central (southern Borderlands terminus, never catalogued). Aberystwyth (AYW) and Carmarthen (CMN) are corridor-significant but explicitly NOT hub-locked.

Three corridors (North Wales, Mid Wales, West Wales) with no inter-corridor through-running within Wales; corridor recorded per station in `class`, not a separate grouping structure (uk/catalog.js has no corridor-grouping concept).

Four doNotGroup candidates (Wrexham General route directions, Carmarthen branch-vs-through-running, Whitland three-way branch, Machynlleth Aberystwyth/Pwllheli split) are PROPOSED ONLY — no platform/service-pattern detail in the D1 pack to build an enforced rule from. Not built here.

No direction-hubs.json for this region — no anchoring through-station candidate (like Greater Anglia's Thetford/Ely -> Norwich) identified in the D1 pack. loadDirectionHubs() degrades to an empty, no-op hub list, same call shape as every other UK region.

CRS codes live-verified 5 Sep 2026 (see docs/jim-brief-uk-crs-corrections.md): Conwy CON->CNW, Holyhead HOY->HHD, Welshpool WEL->WLP, Machynlleth MCH->MCN, Whitland WLD->WTL, Tenby TNB->TEN, Milford Haven MLH->MFH, Fishguard Harbour FGW->FGH (FGW is the separate Fishguard & Goodwick station). All 17 stops crsVerified: true.
Coordinates: NaPTAN RailReferences (CRS->coords) pulled 2026-09-07; 17/17 rail stations geocoded; no exceptions
